# Task report template
- Task ID: Mx-yy
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm +07:00
- Owner: ...
- Status: TODO / IN_PROGRESS / BLOCKED / DONE
- Goal / Acceptance Criteria: ...
- Files changed: ...
- Commands run + results: ...
- Security check: ...
- Deployment (if any): environment, commit, version, rollback point
- Known issues/blockers: ...
- Next task + exact starting action: ...

> Only mark DONE after acceptance criteria/test evidence. Update `PROGRESS.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` in same change as code.
